prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a long sleek blue dragon on four short legs seen from the side, no wings, a long low body of deep blue scales with a pale blue belly, a glowing yellow crest of small fins along the spine, a narrow head with two branching horns shaped like forked lightning, bright yellow eyes, a long tail curled up close behind the hips; the whole dragon, tail tip to snout, sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its narrow blue head with yellow eyes and forked horns is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging the head forward and down with the jaws open toward the heroes, the head above and just in front of its front feet, the crest glowing brighter, all four feet on the ground, the whole dragon well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, all four feet on the ground, the neck pulled back, the eyes shut, the tail coiled tight, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body but keep all four feet on the ground and the body low (no leap, no rearing up): reach the head toward the heroes with the neck bent so the head stays well inside its own cell; the long tail stays curled close behind the hips. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, wings, red scales, green scales, white scales, lightning bolts, breath, sparks, rearing up, a rider.
